tools.name: search_tracks
tools.description: Search DropTrax songs by title or artist name and/or genre (e.g. 'hip-hop', 'house', 'r&b'). Returns title, artist, price in USD, cover art, a preview audio URL when there is one, and the song's page URL.

tools.name: get_track
tools.description: Full public details for one DropTrax song: title, artist, label, price, cover, preview URL, tags, plays and how to buy it.

tools.name: list_new_drops
tools.description: The newest songs on DropTrax, newest first.

tools.name: get_charts
tools.description: DropTrax charts, the same as droptrax.net/charts: 'trending' (buzzing right now), 'top_month' (this month's top songs) or 'top_all_time' (most fans ever).

tools.name: get_buy_link
tools.description: The link where a person can buy a DropTrax song (card, Apple Pay, Google Pay or crypto). Buying happens on that page; no money moves in the chat.

tools.name: about_droptrax
tools.description: Short plain facts about DropTrax: what it is, that uploading is free for artists, how fans pay and how artists get paid.
